caption_zh_polish_en: In this patient, the appearance of blue-black papules with irregular borders on the neck suggests possible diagnoses including blue nevus, melanocytic nevus, seborrheic keratosis, and basal cell epithelioma, further investigations are needed for definitive diagnosis.

caption_zh: 头皮大片黑色斑片;表面粗糙，毛孔明显，边缘不规则.。考虑：脂溢性角化症。
caption_zh_polish: 患者出现头皮大片黑色斑片，表面粗糙，毛孔明显，边缘不规则，符合脂溢性角化症的特征。脂溢性角化症是一种常见的慢性炎症性皮肤病，通常表现为局部皮肤角化过度，形成鳞屑或厚硬的皮屑，常见于头皮、面部、胸部和背部等部位。病因可能与遗传、激素、真菌感染等因素有关。治疗方面，通常采用局部外用角质溶解剂、抗真菌药物等治疗措施。及时就诊并遵医嘱进行治疗可以有效缓解症状。
caption_zh_polish_en: In the case of the patient presenting with large black patches on the scalp, rough surface, prominent pores, and irregular edges, consistent with the features of seborrheic keratosis. Seborrheic keratosis is a common chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by localized overgrowth of the skin, forming scales or thick, hard flakes, commonly found on the scalp, face, chest, back, and other areas. The etiology may be related to genetics, hormones, fungal infections, and other factors. Treatment typically involves the use of topical keratolytic agents, antifungal medications, and other treatment measures. Seeking timely medical attention and following the doctor's advice for treatment can effectively alleviate symptoms.

caption_zh: 手背暗红色结节，中央破溃结痂呈脐窝状。考虑：角化棘皮瘤（皮肤鳞状细胞癌）。建议行病理检查。
caption_zh_polish: 手背暗红色结节，中央破溃结痂呈脐窝状，符合角化棘皮瘤（皮肤鳞状细胞癌）的临床表现。这种肿瘤通常起源于表皮组织，具有角化过程，易发生破溃出血。建议患者尽快进行病理检查，以明确诊断，并制定相应的治疗方案。
caption_zh_polish_en: The dark red nodules on the back of the hand with central ulceration and scab formation resembling a umbilicated appearance are consistent with keratoacanthoma (cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma). This type of tumor typically originates from the epidermal tissue, undergoes keratinization, and is prone to ulceration and bleeding. It is recommended for the patient to undergo pathological examination promptly to confirm the diagnosis and establish an appropriate treatment plan.

caption_zh: 面颊同肤色丘疹。需进一步检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 面颊上出现与皮肤颜色相同的丘疹，可能是多种皮肤问题的表现，包括但不限于痤疮、湿疹或过敏反应。建议就诊皮肤科医生进行详细检查，以明确诊断并制定有效治疗方案。
caption_zh_polish_en: There are papules on the cheeks with the same color as the skin, which could be indicative of various skin conditions such as acne, eczema, or allergic reactions. It is recommended to consult a dermatologist for a detailed examination to confirm the diagnosis and develop an effective treatment plan.

caption_zh: 耳廓3 mm大小半球形丘疹，表面光滑，需收集病史及进一步检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者耳廓出现直径3毫米的半球形丘疹，表面光滑，建议进行详细病史收集和进一步检查，以明确诊断，排除恶性病变。可能的诊断包括耳廓良性丘疹、皮脂腺囊肿等。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient presents with smooth-surfaced, 3mm in diameter, semi-spherical papules on the earlobe. Further evaluation including detailed medical history and additional examinations are recommended to establish a definitive diagnosis and rule out malignancy. Possible diagnoses may include benign papules of the earlobe, sebaceous cysts, among others.

caption_zh: 不规则黑色斑疹，颜色黑色-褐色，周围有暗红色斑。考虑：色素痣待查；黑色素瘤待查。建议行皮肤镜检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 您描述的不规则黑色斑疹，颜色为黑色至褐色，周围有暗红色斑，可能是色素痣或黑色素瘤。建议进行皮肤镜检查以明确诊断，并排除黑色素瘤的可能性。
caption_zh_polish_en: Irregular black pigmented lesions with dark red patches around might be either a melanocytic nevus or a melanoma. It is recommended to undergo a dermoscopic examination for a definite diagnosis and to rule out the possibility of melanoma.

caption_zh: 耳前红色斑疹，中央黑点。考虑：基底细胞癌待查或黑色素瘤。建议行皮肤镜/皮肤活检检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者出现耳前红色斑疹，中央有黑点，疑似基底细胞癌或黑色素瘤，应尽快进行皮肤镜或皮肤活检检查以确诊。
caption_zh_polish_en: Patient presents with red patches in front of the ear with a central black spot, suggestive of basal cell carcinoma or melanoma. It is recommended to undergo dermoscopy or skin biopsy for a definitive diagnosis.

caption_zh: 红斑基底上上丘疹，覆以白色鳞屑，顶端色黑。考虑：皮肤肿瘤待查。需行皮肤镜检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者表现为红斑基底上上丘疹，表面覆盖有白色鳞屑，丘疹顶端出现黑色改变，这种情况下应考虑皮肤肿瘤的可能性，需要进行进一步的检查以明确诊断，建议进行皮肤镜检查。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient presents with erythematous papules with central crusting and black coloration at the top, suggestive of a skin tumor. Further investigation is required for a definitive diagnosis, with dermoscopy examination recommended.

caption_zh: 暗红色半球型丘疹，中央脐窝。考虑：角化棘皮瘤待查。建议行皮肤活检以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者出现在中央脐窝处的暗红色半球型丘疹，考虑可能是角化棘皮瘤。为明确诊断，建议进行皮肤活检。该疾病通常是一种良性肿瘤，常见于头部、颈部和躯干。皮肤活检可以确定病理学特征，帮助确认诊断并制定治疗计划。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient presents with dark red dome-shaped papules in the central umbilicus, suggestive of a possible keratoacanthoma. A skin biopsy is recommended for a definitive diagnosis. Keratoacanthoma is typically a benign tumor that commonly occurs on the head, neck, and trunk. The skin biopsy can confirm the pathological characteristics, aid in confirming the diagnosis, and help in planning the treatment.

caption_zh: 耳廓背侧深溃疡，基底清洁。考虑：皮肤溃疡待查。
caption_zh_polish: 患者出现耳廓背侧深溃疡，基底清洁，需考虑可能为皮肤溃疡的情况。进一步的检查和评估是必要的，以明确诊断并制定相应治疗方案。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient presents with a deep ulcer on the back side of the earlobe with a clean base, suggesting a possibility of skin ulcer. Further investigation and assessment are necessary to confirm the diagnosis and establish an appropriate treatment plan.

caption_zh: 鼻部深溃疡，表面有黄色痂。考虑：皮肤溃疡待查。
caption_zh_polish: 患者鼻部出现深溃疡，病变表面可见黄色痂，考虑为皮肤溃疡，需要进一步检查确诊。溃疡是指在黏膜或皮肤上出现的局部缺损，通常由于感染或血液循环不良引起。常见的原因包括感染、免疫系统异常、药物副作用等。鼻部溃疡可能导致疼痛、瘙痒和局部炎症，严重时可能引起溃疡扩张和疼痛加剧。诊断皮肤溃疡需要综合病史、临床症状和必要的实验室检查。治疗方案通常包括局部清洁护理、抗生素药物和炎症控制。建议及时就医以获得准确诊断和有效治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient presents with a deep ulcer on the nose with a yellow crust on the surface, suggestive of a skin ulcer that requires further investigation. An ulcer refers to a local defect on the mucous membrane or skin, usually caused by infection or poor blood circulation. Common causes include infection, immune system abnormalities, and medication side effects. Nasal ulcers may cause pain, itching, and local inflammation, and when severe, can lead to ulcer expansion and increased pain. Diagnosis of skin ulcers involves a comprehensive assessment of medical history, clinical symptoms, and necessary laboratory tests. Treatment typically includes local wound care, antibiotics, and inflammation control. It is recommended to seek medical attention promptly for an accurate diagnosis and effective treatment.

caption_zh: 暗红色丘疹，中央脐窝。考虑：传染性软疣。
caption_zh_polish: 这种症状描述暗红色的丘疹位于中央脐窝，考虑到传染性软疣。传染性软疣，又称尖锐湿疣，是一种由人类乳头瘤病毒（HPV）感染引起的常见皮肤病变，通常在生殖器周围皮肤和黏膜上出现。这种病变通常呈现为小而柔软的丘疹或肉芽肿，通常是通过性接触传播的。建议患者尽快就医进行确诊和治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: The description of dark red papules located in the central umbilicus is indicative of condyloma acuminatum. Condyloma acuminatum, also known as genital warts, is a common skin condition caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, typically appearing on the skin and mucous membranes around the genital area. These lesions usually present as small, soft papules or nodules and are often transmitted through sexual contact. It is recommended that the patient seek medical attention promptly for diagnosis and treatment.

caption_zh: 下肢环状皮损呈堤状。考虑：环状肉芽肿待查。需行皮肤活检以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 下肢出现环状皮损呈堤状，考虑可能是环状肉芽肿，需要进行皮肤活检以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: Circular skin lesions with a raised appearance on the lower limbs, possibly indicative of granuloma annulare. Skin biopsy is needed for a definitive diagnosis.

caption_zh: 暗红色半球形结节。表面黑色斑点。考虑：色素痣待查；基底细胞癌待查。徐行铸造。
caption_zh_polish: 这是一个患者皮肤上的病变描述，描述了一个暗红色半球形结节，表面有黑色斑点。根据病变的特点，考虑到可能是色素痣或基底细胞癌，需要进一步的检查确认诊断。建议进行切除术并送检。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a description of a lesion on the patient's skin, presenting as a dark red hemispherical nodule with black spots on the surface. Based on the characteristics of the lesion, considerations include a melanocytic nevus or basal cell carcinoma, which require further investigation for confirmation. It is recommended to perform an excision and send for pathological examination.

caption_zh: 手指腹红色丘疹，有深红斑点。考虑：血管瘤待查。需行皮肤镜检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 根据您描述的症状，手指腹出现红色丘疹和深红斑点，可能是血管瘤。血管瘤是一种常见的血管发育异常，通常是良性的。为了明确诊断，建议进行皮肤镜检查。这种检查可以帮助医生观察皮肤表面的细微变化，进一步确认病变性质，从而制定合适的治疗方案。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the symptoms you described, the red papules and dark red spots on the fingertips may suggest a hemangioma. Hemangiomas are common benign vascular abnormalities. To confirm the diagnosis, a skin examination under dermoscopy is recommended. This examination can help the doctor observe subtle changes on the skin surface, further confirming the nature of the lesion and facilitating the development of an appropriate treatment plan.

caption_zh: 这张图片无法准确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 这张图片无法提供足够的信息来做出准确的诊断。建议患者进行进一步的体格检查和医学检验以获取确诊。可能需要进行血液检查、影像学检查或其他相关检查来帮助医生做出正确的诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: Without sufficient information from the image, a precise diagnosis cannot be made. It is recommended for the patient to undergo further physical examinations and medical tests to obtain a confirmed diagnosis. Blood tests, imaging scans, or other relevant investigations may be necessary to assist the healthcare provider in making an accurate diagnosis.

caption_zh: 面部暗红色丘疹，表面光滑。考虑血管瘤。建议做皮肤镜检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者面部出现暗红色丘疹，表面光滑，符合血管瘤的临床表现。血管瘤是一种常见的血管发育异常，通常是良性的。为了明确诊断，建议进行皮肤镜检查，以观察病变部位的细节结构和血管分布情况。这有助于排除其他皮肤病变，如血管瘤的不同亚型或其他可能性的诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient presents with dark red papules on the face, with a smooth surface, which is suggestive of a vascular lesion like a hemangioma. Hemangiomas are common vascular malformations that are usually benign. To confirm the diagnosis, a skin examination with dermoscopy is recommended to observe the detailed structure and vascular distribution of the lesion. This can help rule out other skin conditions, differentiate between subtypes of hemangiomas, or consider other possible diagnoses.

caption_zh: 躯干散在红色丘疹，大小不等，表面光滑。考虑老年性血管瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 在这种情况下，躯干散在红色丘疹，大小不等，表面光滑的症状可能是老年性血管瘤的体征。老年性血管瘤是一种常见的良性血管病变，通常表现为皮肤上的红色或紫红色隆起病变，多见于老年人，特别是白种人。这种血管瘤通常是由于毛细血管扩张、扭曲和异常增生所致。如果症状持续或有其他不适，建议及时就医进行进一步评估和治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: In this case, the scattered red papules of varying sizes on the trunk with a smooth surface may be indicative of senile hemangioma. Senile hemangioma is a common benign vascular lesion characterized by red or purplish-red elevated lesions on the skin, commonly seen in the elderly, particularly in Caucasians. These hemangiomas are usually caused by dilation, twisting, and abnormal proliferation of capillaries. If the symptoms persist or if there are any other discomforts, it is advisable to seek medical attention for further evaluation and treatment.

caption_zh: 躯干黑色丘疹，颜色基本均一，边缘整齐，形状基本对称。考虑：色素痣。需行皮肤镜检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者出现在躯干上的黑色丘疹，颜色基本均一，边缘整齐，形状基本对称，这些特征符合色素痣的表现。为明确诊断，建议进行皮肤镜检查。
caption_zh_polish_en: The black papules on the trunk with uniform color, smooth edges, and symmetrical shape are consistent with a melanocytic nevus. To confirm the diagnosis, a dermatoscopy examination is recommended.

caption_zh: 额部红斑，表面有白色鳞屑。考虑：光线性角化症待查；基底细胞癌待查。需行组织病理学检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者额部出现红斑，表面有白色鳞屑，考虑光线性角化症和基底细胞癌两种可能性，但尚待进一步检查确诊。建议进行组织病理学检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: In a patient with erythematous patches on the forehead with white scales, the differential diagnosis includes actinic keratosis and basal cell carcinoma, further investigation is needed for confirmation. A histopathological examination is recommended for a definitive diagnosis.

caption_zh: 面部半球形丘疹，表面呈不均匀紫黑色。考虑：色素痣。
caption_zh_polish: 面部半球形丘疹，表面呈不均匀紫黑色，符合色素痣的特征。色素痣是一种常见的皮肤病变，通常是由于皮肤色素沉着引起的，多数是良性的。建议定期观察痣的变化，并定期复查以监测其状态。
caption_zh_polish_en: Facial semi-spherical papules with uneven purplish-black color on the surface, consistent with a diagnosis of melanocytic nevus. Melanocytic nevi are common skin lesions typically caused by melanin deposition and are usually benign. It is recommended to monitor the changes of the nevus regularly and follow up periodically to monitor its status.

caption_zh: 这张图片无法准确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 这张图片无法提供足够的信息来做出明确的诊断，建议进行进一步的临床检查和评估。
caption_zh_polish_en: Without sufficient information from the image, a definitive diagnosis cannot be made. Further clinical examinations and assessments are recommended.

caption_zh: 类椭圆形斑疹。考虑：色素痣。需行皮肤镜检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者出现了类椭圆形斑疹，考虑为色素痣。建议进行皮肤镜检查以明确诊断，并排除其他皮肤病变。色素痣是一种常见的皮肤病变，通常是良性的，但仍需及时确诊以规避潜在的风险。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient presents with oval-shaped macules, suggestive of a melanocytic nevus. A dermatoscopy examination is recommended to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other skin lesions. Melanocytic nevi are common skin lesions, typically benign, but it is important to diagnose them promptly to mitigate potential risks.

caption_zh: 棕褐色斑片，表面不平整，边缘不整齐，形状不对称。考虑：黑色素瘤待查。需行组织病理学检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 棕褐色斑片，表面不规则，边缘不规整，形状不对称，具有黑色素瘤的特征。黑色素瘤是一种恶性皮肤肿瘤，通常表现为色素沉着增多的皮损，易于恶变。建议尽快进行皮肤组织活检，通过病理学检查来确诊。
caption_zh_polish_en: Brownish patches with irregular surface, uneven edges, and asymmetrical shape, suggestive of features of melanoma. Melanoma is a malignant skin tumor that typically presents as skin lesions with increased pigmentation, prone to malignant transformation. It is recommended to undergo a skin biopsy promptly for a definite diagnosis through pathological examination.

caption_zh: 棕褐色斑片，表面不平整，边缘不整齐，形状不对称。考虑：黑色素瘤待查。需行组织病理学检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 棕褐色斑片，表面不平整，边缘不整齐，形状不对称，这些特征符合黑色素瘤的临床表现。黑色素瘤是一种恶性皮肤肿瘤，通常呈现为色素沉着不均匀、边缘不规则、颜色不均匀、直径较大等特点。为了明确诊断，需要进行组织病理学检查，包括活检或病理切片检查。
caption_zh_polish_en: The brownish-black patch with uneven surface, irregular borders, and asymmetrical shape is suggestive of melanoma. Melanoma is a malignant skin tumor characterized by uneven pigmentation, irregular borders, color variation, and larger diameter. A histopathological examination, such as biopsy or pathological section examination, is necessary to confirm the diagnosis.

caption_zh: 红色不规则斑片，表面有白色鳞屑。考虑：光线性角化症待查。需行组织病理学检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 红色不规则斑片，表面有白色鳞屑，符合光线性角化症的临床表现。光线性角化症是一种皮肤疾病，通常表现为皮肤局部红斑、鳞屑，边缘不规则。确诊光线性角化症需要进行组织病理学检查，以明确病变的病理特征和程度。
caption_zh_polish_en: The red irregular patches with white scales on the surface are consistent with the clinical manifestations of actinic keratosis. Actinic keratosis is a skin condition characterized by localized red patches with scales and irregular borders. A histopathological examination is required to confirm the diagnosis of actinic keratosis and determine the pathological characteristics and severity of the lesion.

caption_zh: 发际内红色椭圆形丘疹，表面有光泽。考虑：基底细胞癌待查。需行组织病理学检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish: 患者发际内出现红色椭圆形丘疹，表面有光泽，这种症状可能是基底细胞癌的表现，需要进行组织病理学检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: In this case, the patient presents with red shiny oval papules within the hairline, raising suspicion for basal cell carcinoma. Tissue pathology examination is required for a definitive diagnosis.

caption_zh: 这是一张面颊部的皮损照片。可以看到淡红色的斑块，边界清楚，表面覆盖有干燥的黏着性鳞屑。诊断为光线性角化
caption_zh_polish: 这是一张面颊部的皮损照片，表现为淡红色斑块，边界清晰，皮肤表面覆盖有干燥的黏着性鳞屑，符合光线性角化的特征。光线性角化是一种皮肤病变，通常表现为局限性、对称性的角化性增生，常见于面颊、前臂等部位。这种病变可能与阳光照射、遗传因素等有关，一般情况下是良性的，但需要定期观察和保持皮肤清洁，避免刺激或损伤皮肤。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of a skin lesion on the cheek, characterized by pale red patches with clear borders and dry adherent scales on the surface, consistent with actinic keratosis. Actinic keratosis is a skin condition that typically presents as localized, symmetric keratotic growths, commonly found on the cheeks, forearms, and other sun-exposed areas. This condition may be associated with sunlight exposure, genetic factors, among others. In general, it is benign but requires regular observation, maintaining skin cleanliness, and avoiding skin irritation or damage.

caption_zh: 这是一张躯干部的皮损照片。可以看到淡褐色的扁平小斑片，边界清楚，表面有黑褐色的痂皮。诊断为脂溢性角化
caption_zh_polish: 这是一张躯干部皮损的照片。可以观察到淡褐色的扁平小斑片，边界清晰，表面覆盖有黑褐色的痂皮。根据临床表现和皮肤病理学特征，初步诊断为脂溢性角化。这种疾病通常表现为油脂分泌过多导致的角质过度增生，常见于脸部、头皮、胸部和背部等部位。建议进一步就医以获取确诊和治疗方案。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of skin lesions on the trunk. Light brown flat patches with clear borders and black-brown crusts on the surface can be observed. Based on the clinical presentation and histological features, the preliminary diagnosis is seborrheic keratosis. This condition is characterized by excessive sebum production leading to hyperkeratosis, commonly found on the face, scalp, chest, and back. Further medical consultation is recommended for confirmation and treatment.

caption_zh: 这是一张发生在上臂的皮损照片。可以看到黑褐色的圆形小丘疹，表面光滑，边界清楚。局部没有毛发。诊断为色素痣
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片展示了位于上臂的皮肤损伤，表现为黑褐色的圆形小丘疹，皮损表面光滑，边界清晰，周围没有毛发。根据病灶的特征，初步诊断为色素痣。色素痣是一种常见的皮肤良性病变，通常是皮肤色素细胞过度增生形成的，多数情况下是良性的，但仍需定期观察变化。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the characteristics of the lesion, the preliminary diagnosis is a melanocytic nevus. Melanocytic nevus is a common benign skin condition characterized by the overgrowth of melanocytes in the skin, often benign but should still be monitored for any changes.

caption_zh: 这是一张躯干的皮疹照片，可以看到一个深棕色的斑块，中央略隆起，边缘扁平，形状不规则。诊断为发育不良痣
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片展示了躯干上的皮疹，表现为一个中央略隆起的深棕色斑块，边缘扁平且形状不规则。根据病灶特征和临床表现，这种皮肤病变可以诊断为发育不良痣。发育不良痣是一种常见的皮肤病变，通常是先天性的，可能会随着年龄增长而发生变化。建议定期观察病变的大小、形态和颜色变化，如有异常应及时就医进行进一步评估和治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of a rash on the trunk, showing a slightly raised dark brown patch with a flat irregular border in the center. Based on the characteristics of the lesion and the clinical presentation, this skin condition can be diagnosed as a dysplastic nevus. Dysplastic nevus is a common skin condition, usually congenital, and may change with age. It is recommended to regularly observe changes in the size, shape, and color of the lesion, and seek medical attention promptly for further evaluation and treatment.

caption_zh: 这是一张手指的皮损照片，可以看到绿豆大小的皮色斑块，表面粗糙呈疣状。诊断为寻常疣
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了手指上绿豆大小的皮肤损伤，表面呈现粗糙的疣状斑块，这是寻常疣的典型表现。寻常疣是由人类乳头瘤病毒（HPV）感染引起的常见皮肤病，通常在手指、手部和足部出现。这种病变通常是良性的，但可能会引起不适和美容问题。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo showing a green bean-sized skin lesion on the finger, with a rough and wart-like surface, characteristic of common warts. Common warts are a common skin condition caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, typically appearing on the fingers, hands, and feet. These lesions are usually benign but can cause discomfort and cosmetic concerns.

caption_zh: 这是一张面颊部的皮损照片，可以看到黄豆大小的黑褐色半球形结节，孤立散在，表面角化明显。诊断为结节性痒疹
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示面颊部有黄豆大小的黑褐色半球形结节，结节孤立散在，表面有明显的角化。根据症状和体征，这符合结节性痒疹的临床表现。结节性痒疹是一种慢性、复发性皮肤病，通常表现为结节状皮损，伴有瘙痒感。病因尚不明确，可能与免疫反应和遗传因素有关。治疗常包括局部激素外用、抗组胺药物等。患者在治疗过程中应避免搔抓，保持皮肤清洁，避免刺激因素。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo showing black-brown nodules the size of soybeans on the cheek, with nodules scattered isolatedly and with obvious keratinization on the surface. Based on the symptoms and signs, this is consistent with the clinical presentation of nodular prurigo. Nodular prurigo is a chronic, recurrent skin disease characterized by nodular skin lesions and itching. The etiology is not clear, but it may be related to immune reactions and genetic factors. Treatment often includes topical corticosteroids, antihistamines, and other medications. Patients should avoid scratching, keep the skin clean, and avoid irritants during treatment.

caption_zh: 这是一张四肢部的皮肤照片，可以看到黄褐色的卵圆形结节，孤立存在。表面光滑。诊断为皮肤纤维瘤
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示四肢部出现黄褐色的卵圆形结节，呈孤立分布，表面光滑，符合皮肤纤维瘤的特征。皮肤纤维瘤是一种常见的良性皮肤肿瘤，通常是由真皮层纤维组织增生形成。这种肿瘤通常无痛，生长缓慢，多见于成年人。治疗一般情况下是手术切除，通常预后良好。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the appearance of the yellow-brown oval-shaped nodules isolated on the skin of the limbs in the photo, with a smooth surface, the diagnosis of skin fibroma is made. Skin fibroma is a common benign skin tumor, typically characterized by the proliferation of fibrous tissue in the dermis. These tumors are usually painless, slow-growing, and commonly seen in adults. Treatment typically involves surgical removal, with a generally good prognosis.

caption_zh: 这是一张面部的照片，可以看到淡褐色的斑片。诊断为苔藓性角化病
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示面部出现了淡褐色的斑片，结合症状和表现特点，这种情况可能是苔藓性角化病。苔藓性角化病是一种慢性炎症性皮肤病，特征为皮肤上出现鳞屑、斑块和色素沉着，通常影响面部、颈部和胸部。治疗包括局部外用药物和光疗等方法。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the photo showing light brown patches on the face and the characteristic symptoms, the condition is likely to be Xeroderma pigmentosum. Xeroderma pigmentosum is a chronic inflammatory skin disease characterized by the presence of scales, patches, and pigmentation on the skin, commonly affecting the face, neck, and chest. Treatment includes topical medications and phototherapy.

caption_zh: 这是一张上肢的皮损照片，可以看到孤立存在的紫红色结节，表面粗糙。诊断为血管瘤
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片展示了上肢皮肤上的紫红色结节，表面呈现粗糙的情况。根据症状和表现，初步诊断为血管瘤。血管瘤是一种常见的血管发育异常，可以分为毛细血管瘤和动脉静脉瘤两种类型，通常是良性的。血管瘤的治疗取决于病变的类型、大小和位置，包括观察、药物治疗、激光治疗或手术等方式。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the appearance of the isolated purplish-red nodules with a rough surface on the upper limb skin, the preliminary diagnosis is a vascular malformation. Vascular malformations are common anomalies in blood vessels and can be classified into capillary malformations and arteriovenous malformations. They are typically benign. The treatment of vascular malformations depends on the type, size, and location of the lesion and may include observation, medication, laser therapy, or surgery.

caption_zh: 这是一张头部的皮损照片，可以看到左耳上方的单发溃疡，边缘隆起如串珠状，中央有结痂，基底有少量出血。诊断为基底细胞癌
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示头部皮肤出现溃疡，位于左耳上方，边缘隆起如串珠状，中央有结痂，基底有少量出血，根据病灶形态和临床表现，诊断为基底细胞癌。基底细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常生长缓慢，但若不及时治疗，有可能侵犯周围组织和器官。
caption_zh_polish_en: Basal cell carcinoma is diagnosed based on the appearance and clinical presentation of the lesion, which shows an ulcer on the skin of the head above the left ear, with raised edges resembling beads, a scab in the center, and slight bleeding at the base. Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that typically grows slowly, but if not treated promptly, it can invade surrounding tissues and organs.

caption_zh: 这是一张头部的皮损照片，可以看到单发的淡黄色扁平斑块，表面光滑，边缘隆起如串珠状。诊断为基底细胞癌
caption_zh_polish: 这是一张头部皮肤损伤的照片，显示出单个淡黄色扁平斑块，表面光滑，边缘呈串珠状隆起。根据病灶的特征，患者被诊断为基底细胞癌，这是一种常见的皮肤癌类型，通常生长缓慢但具有侵袭性。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of a skin lesion on the head, showing a single flat pale yellow patch with smooth surface and raised beaded edges. Based on the characteristics of the lesion, the patient has been diagnosed with basal cell carcinoma, which is a common type of skin cancer that usually grows slowly but can be locally invasive.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个黑褐色的斑片，形状不规则，诊断为发育不良痣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个黑褐色不规则形状的斑块，经过检查诊断为皮肤发育不良性痣。发育不良性痣是一种在儿童或青少年时期形成的良性皮肤病变，通常不需要治疗，但需要定期观察变化。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows an irregularly shaped dark brown patch, which upon examination is diagnosed as a benign dysplastic nevus. Dysplastic nevi are benign skin lesions that develop during childhood or adolescence, usually requiring no treatment but requiring regular monitoring for changes.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个圆形的鲜红色结节，突起于皮肤表面，表面光滑，诊断为血管瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个圆形的鲜红色结节，突起在皮肤表面，表面光滑，符合血管瘤的临床表现。 血管瘤是一种常见的血管发育异常，通常是由于血管内皮细胞的增生导致的。 血管瘤通常是良性的，但在某些情况下可能需要治疗，例如如果它们引起出血、疼痛或影响外观。治疗血管瘤的方法包括激光治疗、手术切除和药物治疗等。
caption_zh_polish_en: This photo shows a round, bright red nodule protruding from the skin surface, with a smooth surface, consistent with the clinical presentation of a hemangioma. Hemangiomas are a common vascular developmental abnormality, often caused by proliferation of endothelial cells. Hemangiomas are usually benign, but may require treatment in some cases, such as if they cause bleeding, pain, or affect appearance. Treatment options for hemangiomas include laser therapy, surgical excision, and medication.

caption_zh: 这是一张足趾部位的照片，可以看到指甲侧方的凸起及角质增生结节，呈粉红色，诊断为获得性指状纤维角皮瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示足趾部位指甲侧面有明显的凸起和角质增生结节，呈粉红色，符合获得性指状纤维角皮瘤的临床表现。该病症通常是由于长期摩擦或压力导致皮肤过度增生形成，常见于足部。治疗上可以考虑手术切除或其他物理疗法。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of the toe area showing prominent protrusions and keratotic nodules on the side of the nail, appearing pink, consistent with acquired digital fibrokeratoma. This condition is usually caused by prolonged friction or pressure leading to excessive skin growth, commonly seen on the feet. Treatment options may include surgical removal or other physical therapies.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个黑褐色的斑丘疹，表面光滑，边缘清楚，形状规则，诊断为黑素细胞痣。
caption_zh_polish: 黑素细胞痣是一种常见的皮肤病变，通常是一种良性的色素沉着性皮肤病变。黑素细胞痣可以在任何年龄出现，通常是在出生后的前几年或青春期时出现。大多数黑素细胞痣是先天性的，即出生时就存在的。虽然大多数情况下黑素细胞痣是良性的，但有时候也可能变为恶性黑色素瘤。因此，建议定期检查和观察黑素细胞痣的变化，以便及时发现任何异常。
caption_zh_polish_en: The diagnosis of melanocytic nevus is a common skin lesion, typically a benign pigmented skin lesion. Melanocytic nevi can appear at any age, usually in the first few years of life or during adolescence. Most melanocytic nevi are congenital, meaning they are present at birth. Although in most cases melanocytic nevi are benign, sometimes they can transform into malignant melanoma. Therefore, regular monitoring and observation of changes in melanocytic nevi are recommended to promptly detect any abnormalities.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个棕红色的丘疹，隆起于皮肤表面，局部有少量结痂，诊断为化脓性肉芽肿。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示皮肤表面有一个棕红色的丘疹，局部出现少量结痂，符合化脓性肉芽肿的临床表现。化脓性肉芽肿是一种由细菌感染引起的炎症性皮肤病变，常见于面部、颈部和四肢等部位。治疗通常包括局部抗生素药膏或口服抗生素，严重情况下可能需要手术干预。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a brownish-red papule on the skin surface with localized crusting, consistent with the clinical presentation of pyogenic granuloma. Pyogenic granuloma is an inflammatory skin condition caused by bacterial infection, commonly seen on the face, neck, and extremities. Treatment usually involves topical or oral antibiotics, and in severe cases, surgical intervention may be needed.

caption_zh: 这是一张鼻部的照片，可以看到单发的丘疹，粉红色，表面光滑，稍发亮，诊断为外毛根鞘瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示鼻部有单个丘疹，呈粉红色，表面光滑，稍微发亮，符合外毛根鞘瘤的临床表现。外毛根鞘瘤是一种常见的良性皮肤病变，通常是毛囊周围的囊肿，常见于面部及颈部。多数情况下无需治疗，但如果病变有症状或影响美观，可考虑手术切除。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of the nose showing a single pinkish, smooth, slightly shiny papule, consistent with the clinical presentation of an epidermal cyst. Epidermal cysts are common benign skin lesions that are usually cysts around hair follicles, commonly found on the face and neck. In most cases, they do not require treatment, but if the lesion is symptomatic or cosmetically bothersome, surgical removal may be considered.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到单发的高出皮面的结节，表面光滑，正常肤色。诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示皮肤表面上突起的结节，结节表面光滑，颜色正常。这种表现符合基底细胞癌的特征，是一种常见的皮肤恶性肿瘤，通常生长缓慢，但有潜在的侵袭性。
caption_zh_polish_en: The image shows a raised nodule on the skin with a smooth surface and normal color. These features are consistent with characteristics of basal cell carcinoma, which is a common type of skin malignancy that typically grows slowly but has potential invasiveness.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个鲜红色的斑块，部分有破溃，糜烂和溃疡，部分有褐色的色素。诊断为原位鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个鲜红色的斑块，部分出现了溃疡、糜烂，并有褐色色素沉积。这些表现是原位鳞状细胞癌的特征。原位鳞状细胞癌是一种癌前病变，通常在皮肤或黏膜表面形成，具有潜在恶性转化的风险。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a bright red patch with areas of ulceration, erosion, and brown pigmentation. These features are consistent with in situ squamous cell carcinoma. In situ squamous cell carcinoma is a precancerous lesion that typically forms on the surface of the skin or mucosa, with a risk of potential malignant transformation.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个单发的鲜红色斑块，有浸润性，中央有溃疡。诊断为原位鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个单发的鲜红色斑块，表现出浸润性生长，中央部位出现溃疡。根据病灶的特征，可以诊断为原位鳞状细胞癌。这种类型的癌症通常起源于皮肤或黏膜表层的鳞状细胞，可以通过组织活检确认诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: In this photo, a single bright red patch with infiltrative growth and central ulceration is observed, indicating a diagnosis of in situ squamous cell carcinoma. This type of cancer typically originates from squamous cells in the superficial layer of the skin or mucous membranes, and can be confirmed through tissue biopsy.

caption_zh: 这是一张足跖部位的照片，可以看到黑褐色的斑片，形状不对称，边缘不规则，颜色不均匀，诊断为恶性黑素瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示足跖部位出现黑褐色的不规则斑块，边缘不规则且颜色不均匀，这些特征与恶性黑素瘤相符。恶性黑素瘤是一种恶性皮肤肿瘤，通常表现为色素瘤细胞的恶性增生。这种肿瘤可以迅速生长并具有转移的倾向，因此早期诊断和治疗至关重要。建议立即就医进行进一步评估和治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the description of the photo showing dark brown patches with asymmetric shape, irregular borders, and uneven color on the foot dorsum, the diagnosis is malignant melanoma. Malignant melanoma is a type of malignant skin tumor characterized by the malignant proliferation of melanocytes. This tumor can grow rapidly and has a tendency to metastasize, so early diagnosis and treatment are crucial. Immediate medical attention is recommended for further evaluation and treatment.

caption_zh: 这是一张足部的照片，可以看到单个的淡红色结节，表面光滑，轻度破溃，诊断为小汗腺汗孔瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 小汗腺汗孔瘤是一种常见的皮肤疾病，通常是由于汗腺导管阻塞导致汗液在皮肤下堆积形成的。这种瘤体通常呈现为单个的淡红色结节，表面光滑，有时可能会出现轻度破溃。治疗上通常可以选择手术切除或局部激光治疗等方法。
caption_zh_polish_en: A single pale red nodule with a smooth surface and mild erosion seen in the photo is diagnosed as a hidrocystoma. Hidrocystoma is a common skin condition, usually caused by the blockage of sweat gland ducts leading to the accumulation of sweat under the skin. These lesions typically present as solitary pale red nodules with a smooth surface, sometimes with mild erosion. Treatment options may include surgical excision or local laser therapy.

caption_zh: 这是一张躯干部位的照片，可以看到隆起于皮肤表面的结节，正常肤色，中央有小的开口，诊断为表皮囊肿。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了躯干部位的结节，表面隆起，肤色正常，中央有小的开口，结合临床表现可诊断为表皮囊肿。表皮囊肿是一种常见的皮肤病变，通常是由于毛囊口阻塞引起的，病变通常呈良性，一般无需特殊处理，但如有炎症或症状明显影响生活质量，可考虑手术切除。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo showing a nodule on the trunk area, with a central opening and normal skin color, which is diagnosed as an epidermal cyst based on clinical presentation. Epidermal cyst is a common skin condition usually caused by blockage of hair follicles. The lesion is typically benign and often does not require specific treatment. However, if there is inflammation or significant symptoms affecting quality of life, surgical excision can be considered.

caption_zh: 这是一张耳部的照片，可以看到局部的包块，隆起于皮肤表面，正常肤色，诊断为淋巴细胞反应性增生。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示耳部局部出现包块，隆起于皮肤表面，呈现正常肤色，根据症状和体征，可能是淋巴细胞反应性增生的表现。淋巴细胞反应性增生是机体对外界刺激（如感染、炎症等）的一种免疫反应，通常是局部淋巴组织增生所致。建议进一步检查以明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of the ear showing a localized lump, protruding from the skin surface, with normal skin color. Based on the symptoms and signs, it may be indicative of reactive lymphocytic hyperplasia. Reactive lymphocytic hyperplasia is an immune response of the body to external stimuli such as infection, inflammation, etc., usually resulting from localized lymphoid tissue proliferation. Further investigations are recommended for a definitive diagnosis.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个褐色的斑疹，形状为圆形，表面光滑，边界清楚，诊断为黑素细胞痣。
caption_zh_polish: 黑素细胞痣是一种常见的皮肤病变，通常是皮肤上的一种色素沉着，呈现为褐色或黑色的斑点或斑疹。这种痣通常是圆形或椭圆形，在皮肤表面光滑，边界清晰。黑素细胞痣通常是良性的，但在特定情况下也可能发展为恶性黑色素瘤，因此定期检查和监测是非常重要的。
caption_zh_polish_en: Black melanocytic nevus is a common skin lesion, typically presenting as pigmented spots or patches on the skin in shades of brown or black. These nevi are usually round or oval in shape, with smooth surfaces and clear borders. While melanocytic nevi are usually benign, they can potentially progress to malignant melanoma in certain cases, highlighting the importance of regular examination and monitoring.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个淡褐色的斑片，边缘不清楚，形状不规则，诊断为发育不良痣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示出一个淡褐色的斑块，边缘不清晰，形状不规则，根据病灶的特征，可以诊断为发育不良性痣。发育不良性痣通常是皮肤上的一种良性病变，虽然大多数情况下无需治疗，但仍建议定期复查以监测病变的变化。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the characteristics of the lesion, the photo shows a light brown patch with unclear edges and irregular shape, suggesting a diagnosis of a dysplastic nevus. Dysplastic nevi are typically benign skin lesions that often do not require treatment; however, regular follow-up examinations are recommended to monitor any changes in the lesion.

caption_zh: 这是一张足趾部位的照片，可以看到一个淡褐色的斑片，边缘不清楚，形状不规则，颜色分布不对称，诊断为发育不良痣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了足趾部位的一个淡褐色斑块，边缘不规则，颜色分布不对称，符合发育不良痣的特征。建议及时就医进行皮肤科检查，排除恶性黑色素瘤等皮肤疾病。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the description provided, the photo shows a light brown patch on the toe area with irregular borders and asymmetric color distribution, consistent with a dysplastic nevus. It is recommended to seek prompt medical attention for a dermatological examination to rule out skin conditions such as melanoma.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个半球形的褐色丘疹，表面光滑，形状规则，边界清楚，诊断为黑素细胞痣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片展示了一个半球形的褐色丘疹，其表面光滑，形状规则，边界清晰，根据这些特征，可以诊断为黑素细胞痣。黑素细胞痣是一种常见的良性皮肤病变，通常是由黑色素细胞的聚集导致的，大多数情况下是无害的，但在一些情况下也可能发展为恶性黑色素瘤，因此需要定期观察和监测。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a dome-shaped brown papule with a smooth surface, regular shape, and clear borders, indicating a diagnosis of melanocytic nevus. Melanocytic nevus is a common benign skin lesion, typically caused by the clustering of melanocytes. While most cases are harmless, in some instances, it may progress to malignant melanoma, highlighting the importance of regular observation and monitoring.

caption_zh: 这是一张手部的照片，可以看到单个的溃疡样损害，诊断为化脓性肉芽肿。
caption_zh_polish: 这是一张手部的照片，显示了单个溃疡样损害，结合患者的症状和体征，考虑到化脓性肉芽肿的可能性较大。化脓性肉芽肿是一种炎症性病变，通常由细菌感染引起，表现为组织局部的肿胀、红肿、溃疡及化脓等症状。
caption_zh_polish_en: In this photo of the hand, a single ulcer-like lesion is visible. Considering the patient's symptoms and signs, pyogenic granuloma is likely. Pyogenic granuloma is an inflammatory condition typically caused by bacterial infection, presenting with local tissue swelling, redness, ulceration, and suppuration.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到鲜红色的斑块，隆起于皮肤表面，周边有密集分布的脓疱，诊断为皮肤球孢子菌病。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示皮肤表面有鲜红色的斑块，隆起且周边有密集分布的脓疱，符合皮肤球孢子菌病的临床表现。这种疾病是由真菌引起的皮肤感染，常见于潮湿温暖的环境下，可通过临床症状和真菌培养确诊。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photograph shows red patches raised on the skin surface with clustered pustules around it, consistent with the clinical presentation of cutaneous sporotrichosis. This condition is a fungal skin infection commonly found in moist and warm environments, and it can be diagnosed through clinical symptoms and fungal culture.

caption_zh: 这是一张面颊部的照片，可以看到单发的疣状损害，表面粗糙，诊断为鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张面颊部照片显示出单发的疣状损害，表面粗糙，结合临床病史和病灶特点，高度怀疑为鳞状细胞癌，需要进一步进行组织病理学检查以确诊。
caption_zh_polish_en: In this photo of the cheek, a single verrucous lesion with a rough surface is visible, highly suspicious for squamous cell carcinoma based on clinical history and lesion characteristics. Further histopathological examination is needed for confirmation.

caption_zh: 这是一张脸颊部位的照片，可以看到鲜红色的坚实结节，隆起于皮肤表面，诊断为皮肤白血病。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示脸颊部位出现鲜红色的坚实结节，隆起于皮肤表面，患者可能患有皮肤白血病，这是一种罕见的白血病亚型，通常表现为皮肤病变。皮肤白血病是一种白血病的特殊类型，白血病细胞聚集在皮肤中，形成结节或斑块。这种疾病通常需要通过组织活检和血液检查来确诊。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows red solid nodules on the cheek, protruding from the skin surface, possibly indicating cutaneous leukemia. This is a rare subtype of leukemia that typically presents with skin manifestations. Cutaneous leukemia is a specific type of leukemia where leukemia cells cluster in the skin, forming nodules or patches. Diagnosis of this condition usually requires tissue biopsy and blood tests.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到单发的淡褐色扁平小斑片，边界清楚，表面粗糙，诊断为脂溢性角化。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示单个淡褐色、扁平的小斑片，边界清晰，表面粗糙，符合脂溢性角化的特征。脂溢性角化是一种常见的皮肤病，通常表现为皮肤表面角质过度增生，形成斑块或鳞屑。这种情况通常是由于皮脂腺分泌过多油脂，导致毛囊口堵塞所致。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a single, flat, tan-colored patch with clear borders and a rough surface, consistent with seborrheic keratosis. Seborrheic keratosis is a common skin condition characterized by overgrowth of keratin on the skin surface, leading to the formation of patches or scales. This condition is typically caused by overproduction of sebum by the sebaceous glands, resulting in blocked hair follicles.

caption_zh: 这是一张鼻翼部位的照片，可以看到单个斑块，局部溃烂成菜花样，诊断为皮脂腺癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示鼻翼部位有单个斑块，局部溃烂呈菜花状，根据表现特征和病变形态，高度怀疑为皮脂腺癌。皮脂腺癌是一种恶性肿瘤，通常起源于皮肤的皮脂腺组织，具有侵袭性和转移性。建议尽快就医进行进一步的诊断和治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the appearance of a single patch with local ulceration resembling a cauliflower in the nasal ala area, the highly suspected diagnosis is sebaceous gland carcinoma. Sebaceous gland carcinoma is a malignant tumor that typically originates from the sebaceous glands in the skin, known for its invasive and metastatic potential. It is recommended to seek medical attention promptly for further diagnosis and treatment.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到单发的紫红色结节，表面光滑，局部可见毛细血管扩张，诊断为血管瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个单发的紫红色结节，表面光滑，局部可见毛细血管扩张，符合血管瘤的临床特征。血管瘤是一种常见的血管发育异常，通常是良性的。治疗取决于血管瘤的类型、大小和位置，可以采用激光治疗、手术切除或药物治疗等方式。
caption_zh_polish_en: From the photo, a single purple-red nodule with smooth surface and visible local capillary dilation is observed, which is consistent with the clinical features of a hemangioma. Hemangiomas are common vascular developmental abnormalities that are typically benign. Treatment depends on the type, size, and location of the hemangioma and may include options such as laser therapy, surgical excision, or medication.

caption_zh: 这是一张前额部的照片，可以看到单发的结节，边界清楚。中央有溃疡和红棕色的痂皮，边缘呈串珠样隆起。诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这是一张前额部的照片，显示出单个的结节，边界清晰。中央可见溃疡和红棕色的痂皮，边缘呈串珠状隆起。这些表现符合基底细胞癌的特征，基底细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常生长缓慢，但若不及时治疗可能会侵犯深层组织。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of a lesion on the frontal area, displaying a single nodular growth with well-defined borders. In the center, there is an ulceration with reddish-brown crust, and the edges appear raised like a string of beads. These features are consistent with basal cell carcinoma, a common type of skin cancer that typically grows slowly but can invade deeper tissues if not treated promptly.

caption_zh: 这是一张手背部位的照片，可以看到灰白色的角化性扁平斑块，表面有少量的鳞屑，诊断为光线性角化。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示手背部位出现灰白色的角化性扁平斑块，表面有少量鳞屑，符合光线性角化的临床表现特征。光线性角化是一种皮肤疾病，通常表现为皮肤局部角化过度，形成扁平斑块，常见于日光暴露部位。这种情况通常是由于长期暴露在紫外线下引起的，需要避免阳光直射，定期复查以观察病情变化。治疗方面主要包括局部角质软化剂和避免紫外线暴露。保持皮肤湿润也是重要的辅助措施。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows gray-white keratotic flat plaques with some scales on the back of the hand, consistent with the clinical features of actinic keratosis. Actinic keratosis is a skin condition characterized by localized excessive keratinization, forming flat plaques, commonly found in sun-exposed areas. This condition is usually caused by prolonged exposure to ultraviolet radiation and requires avoiding direct sunlight and regular follow-up to monitor changes in the condition. Treatment typically includes topical keratolytic agents and sun protection. Keeping the skin moisturized is also an important supportive measure.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到多个息肉样的凸起，表面光滑，正常肤色，诊断为软纤维瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示多个表面光滑的息肉样凸起，呈现正常肤色，根据病灶特征可初步诊断为软纤维瘤。软纤维瘤是一种常见的良性皮肤肿瘤，通常无需治疗，但定期观察病情变化是必要的。
caption_zh_polish_en: This photo shows multiple smooth surfaced polypoid protrusions with normal skin color, which is preliminarily diagnosed as a soft fibroma based on the characteristics of the lesion. Soft fibroma is a common benign skin tumor that usually does not require treatment, but regular monitoring of the condition is necessary.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个灰褐色的斑块，表面粗糙呈疣状，突起于皮面，与周边分界清楚，诊断为寻常疣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个灰褐色的斑块，表面呈现粗糙疣状，突起于皮肤表面，并且与周围区域有明确的分界线，根据病灶的特征，可以诊断为寻常疣。寻常疣是一种由人类乳头状瘤病毒（HPV）感染引起的常见皮肤病，通常在手部、脚底、膝盖等部位出现，是一种良性的皮肤病变。治疗方式包括冷冻疗法、外科手术切除、药物治疗等。
caption_zh_polish_en: From the description provided, the image shows a gray-brown patch with a rough, wart-like surface that protrudes from the skin and has a clear boundary with the surrounding area, indicating a diagnosis of common warts. Common warts are a common skin condition caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, typically appearing on areas such as the hands, soles of the feet, and knees. It is a benign skin lesion that can be treated with methods such as cryotherapy, surgical excision, and medication.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个单发的巨大结节，明显高出平面，表面光滑，可看到扩张的毛细血管。诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个突出的巨大结节，表面光滑，可见扩张的毛细血管，符合基底细胞癌的特征。基底细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常生长缓慢，但若不及时治疗可能会侵犯邻近组织。治疗方式包括手术切除、冷冻疗法、放射疗法等。患者应定期接受随访以监测病情。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a prominent large nodule with a smooth surface and dilated blood vessels, characteristic of basal cell carcinoma. Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that typically grows slowly but can invade nearby tissues if not treated promptly. Treatment options include surgical removal, cryotherapy, radiation therapy, among others. Patients should undergo regular follow-ups to monitor the condition.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个黑褐色的扁平小斑片，边界清楚，表面略粗糙，部分有油腻的痂皮，诊断为脂溢性角化病。
caption_zh_polish: 脂溢性角化病是一种常见的皮肤疾病，通常表现为皮肤上出现黑褐色的扁平小斑片，边界清楚，表面略粗糙，有时会有油腻的痂皮。这种疾病主要是由皮脂腺的分泌过多引起的，会导致角质过度增生。治疗通常包括局部药物治疗和皮肤护理。
caption_zh_polish_en: Seborrheic keratosis is a common skin condition characterized by the presence of flat, brownish patches on the skin with clear borders, slightly rough surface, and sometimes greasy scales. It is mainly caused by overproduction of sebaceous glands, leading to excessive keratinization. Treatment typically involves topical medications and skin care.

caption_zh: 这是一张前额部位的照片，可以看到单发的溃疡，中央有红棕色的结痂和出血，边缘略隆起呈串珠样，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了前额部位的单发溃疡，中央有红棕色的结痂和出血，边缘略呈串珠状隆起，这些表现符合基底细胞癌的特征。基底细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常生长缓慢，但若不及时治疗可能会扩散造成更严重的问题。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo showing a single ulcer on the frontal area, with a reddish-brown crust and bleeding in the center, and slightly raised bead-like edges, which are consistent with the characteristics of basal cell carcinoma. Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that typically grows slowly but can spread and cause more serious issues if not treated promptly.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个紫红色的囊状结构，隆起于皮面，表面光滑，与周围分界清楚，诊断为血管瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示皮肤表面凸起的紫红色囊状结构，外观光滑，与周围清晰分隔，符合血管瘤的特征。血管瘤是一种常见的血管发育异常，通常是由于血管壁的异常发育导致。这种情况通常是良性的，但在某些情况下可能需要治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: On this image, there is a raised purplish-red cystic structure on the skin surface, with a smooth appearance and clear demarcation from the surrounding area, consistent with a diagnosis of hemangioma. Hemangiomas are common vascular malformations, usually resulting from abnormal development of blood vessel walls. This condition is typically benign but may require treatment in certain cases.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到淡黄色的小丘疹，隆起于皮面，表面光滑，诊断为汗管瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示皮肤上出现了淡黄色的小丘疹，这些丘疹呈现出隆起的形态，表面光滑，符合汗管瘤的临床表现特征。
caption_zh_polish_en: In this photo, there are light yellow papules on the skin, which appear raised and have a smooth surface, consistent with the clinical features of a syringoma.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个淡褐色的斑块，中央可见浅溃疡，边缘略隆起。诊断为原位鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个淡褐色的斑块，中央可见浅溃疡，边缘略隆起，这是原位鳞状细胞癌的典型表现。原位鳞状细胞癌是一种局限性的早期鳞状细胞癌，通常在皮肤表面形成，未侵犯深层组织。这种病变通常可以通过手术切除来治疗，预后良好。
caption_zh_polish_en: This photograph shows a light brown patch with a superficial ulcer in the center and slightly raised edges, which is a typical presentation of in situ squamous cell carcinoma. In situ squamous cell carcinoma is a localized early-stage squamous cell carcinoma that typically forms on the surface of the skin without invading deeper tissues. This condition can usually be treated with surgical excision and has a good prognosis.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到大量的边界清楚的红色斑块，隆起于皮肤表面，有浸润性，诊断为皮肤转移癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了皮肤表面大量边界清晰的红色隆起斑块，具有浸润性特征，这是皮肤转移癌的典型表现。皮肤转移癌是癌症细胞从原发部位（通常是其他器官）转移至皮肤的疾病，通常表现为皮肤上的肿块或斑块。这种情况需要进一步的临床评估和治疗，包括确定原发癌症的部位和分期，以制定合适的治疗方案。
caption_zh_polish_en: This photo shows a large number of red raised patches with clear borders on the skin surface, demonstrating infiltrative features characteristic of cutaneous metastatic carcinoma. Cutaneous metastatic carcinoma is a condition where cancer cells from a primary site (usually another organ) spread to the skin, typically presenting as nodules or patches on the skin. This condition requires further clinical evaluation and treatment, including determining the primary site and staging of the cancer to develop an appropriate treatment plan.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个黑褐色的半球形丘疹，中央略凹陷，表面光滑，边界清楚，诊断为黑素细胞痣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片展示了一个黑褐色的半球形丘疹，中央稍微凹陷，表面光滑，边界清晰，这种病变的临床特征符合黑素细胞痣的特点。黑素细胞痣是一种常见的良性皮肤病变，通常呈现为色素沉着的小突起，大多数情况下无需治疗，但需要定期检查以监测任何变化。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photograph shows a black-brown dome-shaped papule with a slightly central depression, smooth surface, and clear borders, characteristic of a melanocytic nevus. Melanocytic nevi are common benign skin lesions that typically present as pigmented raised bumps, usually requiring no treatment in most cases but necessitating regular monitoring for any changes.

caption_zh: 这是一张大腿部位的照片，可以看到黄褐色的圆形斑块，诊断为皮肤纤维瘤
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示大腿部位出现黄褐色的圆形斑块，根据病灶的特征和表现，初步诊断为皮肤纤维瘤。皮肤纤维瘤是一种常见的良性皮肤肿瘤，通常为圆形或椭圆形，表面光滑，颜色多为黄褐色或肉色。这种肿瘤通常生长缓慢，一般不会引起疼痛或不适，但有时会因摩擦或外伤导致出血或疼痛。需要进一步的皮肤科检查以确认诊断，并讨论是否需要治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of the thigh showing yellow-brown circular patches, which is preliminarily diagnosed as a dermatofibroma based on the characteristics and appearance of the lesion. Dermatofibroma is a common benign skin tumor, usually round or oval in shape, with a smooth surface and yellow-brown or flesh-colored. This type of tumor tends to grow slowly and generally does not cause pain or discomfort, but sometimes it may bleed or be painful due to friction or trauma. Further dermatological examination is needed to confirm the diagnosis and discuss the need for treatment.

caption_zh: 这是一张足部的照片，可以看到足底暗红色的斑片，表面覆有少量鳞屑，角化明显，诊断为足癣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示足部足底有暗红色斑片，表面有少量鳞屑，皮肤角化明显，符合足癣的临床表现。足癣是由足部真菌感染引起的一种皮肤病，常见症状包括瘙痒、灼热感和脱屑。治疗足癣通常包括局部外用抗真菌药物，如克霉唑或咪康唑，有时需要口服抗真菌药物。同时，保持足部干燥清洁，避免穿潮湿鞋袜也是预防足癣的重要措施。
caption_zh_polish_en: This photo shows dark red patches on the sole of the foot with some scales, and notable skin keratinization, consistent with the clinical presentation of tinea pedis. Tinea pedis is a skin condition caused by a fungal infection of the foot, common symptoms include itching, burning sensation, and scaling. Treatment for tinea pedis typically involves topical antifungal medications such as clotrimazole or miconazole, sometimes oral antifungal medications are necessary. Additionally, keeping the feet dry and clean, and avoiding wearing damp shoes and socks are important measures to prevent tinea pedis.

caption_zh: 这是一张面颊部位的照片，可以看到单发的暗红色扁平斑块，略有浸润，部分表面有结痂，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了面颊部位的单个暗红色扁平斑块，略带浸润，部分表面有结痂，临床诊断为基底细胞癌。这种癌症通常生长缓慢，但会不断扩张并侵犯周围组织。治疗选择通常包括手术切除、放疗或冷冻治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a single dark red flat patch on the cheek, slightly infiltrated, with some crusting on the surface, clinically diagnosed as basal cell carcinoma. This type of cancer typically grows slowly but can gradually expand and invade surrounding tissues. Treatment options usually include surgical excision, radiation therapy, or cryotherapy.

caption_zh: 这是一张面颊部的照片，可以看到单发的结节，高出于皮面，表面光滑，有明显的褐色色素沉着，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张面颊部照片显示出一处单发的突起结节，高于皮肤表面，表面光滑，有明显的褐色色素沉着。根据病变的特征，初步诊断为基底细胞癌。基底细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常生长缓慢，但容易侵袭周围组织，早期治疗效果较好。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of a lesion on the cheek, showing a single raised nodule above the skin surface with smooth texture and obvious brown pigmentation deposition. Based on the characteristics of the lesion, a preliminary diagnosis of basal cell carcinoma is made. Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that typically grows slowly but can invade surrounding tissues easily, with good treatment outcomes in the early stages.

caption_zh: 这张照片可看到一个单发的息肉样突起。表面光滑，正常肤色，诊断为软纤维瘤。

Basal cell carcinoma is one of the most common malignant tumors of the skin, usually originating from the basal layer of the skin cells. This type of tumor often grows slowly, but if not treated promptly, it may invade surrounding tissues. caption_zh_polish: 光线性角化是一种常见的皮肤病变，通常表现为皮肤局部增厚、角质层过度增生，形成扁平斑块，常伴有局部干燥鳞屑。这种病变多数情况下由长期接触紫外线引起，如阳光照射等。治疗上可考虑局部糖皮质激素类药膏，避免长时间暴露在紫外线下。
caption_zh_polish_en: Light linear keratosis is a common skin condition characterized by localized skin thickening, excessive proliferation of the stratum corneum, forming flat plaques, often accompanied by local dry scales. This condition is mostly caused by long-term exposure to ultraviolet light, such as sunlight exposure. Treatment may involve the use of topical corticosteroid creams and avoiding prolonged exposure to ultraviolet light.

caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个高于皮肤表面的单发鲜红色结节，表面光滑，根据病理特征诊断为基底细胞癌。基底细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤恶性肿瘤，通常生长缓慢，但有潜在侵袭性。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a single red nodule above the skin surface with smooth texture, diagnosed as basal cell carcinoma based on pathological characteristics. Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of skin malignancy that typically grows slowly but may have potential invasiveness.

caption_zh: 这是一张面部的照片，可以看到一个单发的结节，表面光滑，淡红色，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张面部照片显示一个单发的结节，表面光滑，颜色淡红，符合基底细胞癌的临床表现。基底细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常生长缓慢，具有边缘清晰、表面光滑、颜色较为一致的特点。诊断基底细胞癌通常需要结合临床表现、病史、皮肤活检等多方面信息进行综合判断。
caption_zh_polish_en: Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer, characterized by slow growth, well-defined borders, smooth surface, and uniform color. Diagnosis of basal cell carcinoma typically requires a comprehensive assessment of clinical presentation, medical history, skin biopsy, and other relevant information.

caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a bright red, slightly infiltrated patch on the skin with some scabs on the surface, which is indicative of basal cell carcinoma. However, if there are symptoms or it affects appearance, surgical removal or other treatment options can be considered. Regular follow-up is recommended to monitor the progression of the condition.

caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示鼻翼旁一个淡褐色的半球形丘疹，表面光滑，边界清楚，经诊断为黑素细胞痣，属于一种良性皮肤病变。黑素细胞痣是由黑色素细胞在皮肤中过度增生形成的，通常是先天性的，多数情况下是良性的，一般无需治疗，但需定期观察变化。如痣的颜色、形状、大小或边界发生变化，应及时就医进行进一步评估。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a light brown dome-shaped papule next to the nasal ala, with a smooth surface and clear borders, diagnosed as a melanocytic nevus. Melanocytic nevus is a benign skin lesion caused by the overgrowth of melanocytes in the skin, usually congenital and mostly benign. It generally does not require treatment but regular monitoring for changes is recommended. If the color, shape, size, or borders of the nevus change, prompt medical attention for further evaluation is necessary.

Based on the characteristics of the lesion, the preliminary diagnosis is in situ squamous cell carcinoma. In situ squamous cell carcinoma is a precancerous condition that typically appears on sun-exposed skin areas and usually requires surgical removal of the affected tissue for treatment. It is recommended to seek medical attention early to develop an effective treatment plan.

caption_zh: 这是一张口唇部位的照片，可以看到单发的鲜红色溃疡，中央坏死，有少量脓样分泌物。诊断为鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这是一张口唇部位的照片，显示出单发的鲜红色溃疡，中央坏死，并有少量脓样分泌物。根据病灶的特征和病理表现，临床诊断为口唇鳞状细胞癌。鳞状细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤恶性肿瘤，通常起源于表皮组织，易发生在头颈部位，早期表现为溃疡、结节或增生。治疗方面通常需要手术切除病变组织，并根据病情进展情况考虑放疗或化疗等综合治疗方案。

Squamous cell carcinoma is a common malignant tumor of the skin, usually originating from the epidermal tissue and commonly found in the head and neck region. Early manifestations include ulcers, nodules, or hyperplasia. Treatment typically involves surgical removal of the lesion tissue, with consideration of comprehensive treatment options such as radiotherapy or chemotherapy depending on the progression of the disease.

caption_zh_polish_en: This photo shows clustered brown macules on the skin with clear borders and smooth surfaces, based on the symptom description and observation, it can be diagnosed as freckle-like nevus. Freckle-like nevus is a common skin lesion, usually benign, presenting as brown spots or patches on the skin, commonly found on exposed areas such as the face, neck, and hands. While treatment is generally not necessary, regular examination and monitoring are essential to ensure the benign nature of the lesion.

caption_zh: 这是一张上肢的照片，可以看到一个淡褐色的扁平大斑片，边界清楚，形状不规则，表面略粗糙，部分有油腻的痂皮，诊断为脂溢性角化病。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个上肢上的淡褐色扁平大斑片，边界清楚，形状不规则，表面略显粗糙，部分区域有油腻的痂皮，这些特征符合脂溢性角化病的临床表现。脂溢性角化病是一种常见的皮肤疾病，通常表现为局部皮肤角质过度增生，形成鳞屑状斑块，常见于面部、头皮、胸背等部位。治疗上可以采用角质调理剂、局部激素类药物等方法，严重病例可能需要口服维生素A类药物或光疗等综合治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: On this picture of the upper limb, there is a light brown flat patch with clear borders, irregular shape, slightly rough surface, and some greasy crusts. These features are consistent with the clinical presentation of seborrheic keratosis. Seborrheic keratosis is a common skin condition characterized by localized overgrowth of keratinocytes, forming scaly plaques, commonly found on the face, scalp, chest, and back. Treatment options include keratolytic agents, topical corticosteroids, and in severe cases, oral retinoids or phototherapy may be necessary.

caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个黑褐色的斑丘疹，形态对称，边界不规则，颜色分布不均匀，符合黑素瘤的特征。黑素瘤是一种恶性肿瘤，通常起源于皮肤中的黑色素细胞，可能会发展成为皮肤癌。建议尽快就医进行进一步的评估和治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: This photo shows a dark brown macule with symmetric shape, irregular borders, and uneven color distribution, consistent with features of melanoma. It is advisable to seek medical attention promptly for further evaluation and treatment.

caption_zh_polish_en: This image shows multiple normal-colored skin-colored papules on the scalp, with a smooth surface. caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示腹部出现多发的正常肤色的皮下结节，结节表面光滑，符合脂肪瘤的临床特征。脂肪瘤是一种常见的良性软组织肿瘤，通常由脂肪细胞组成，多生长在皮下组织中。大多数情况下，脂肪瘤是无痛的，通常不需要治疗，但如果出现症状或者影响外观，可以考虑手术切除。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo showing multiple subcutaneous nodules with normal skin color on the abdomen, with smooth surfaces, consistent with the clinical features of lipoma. Lipoma is a common benign soft tissue tumor, typically composed of fat cells and often found in subcutaneous tissues. In most cases, lipomas are painless and do not require treatment. However, if symptoms occur or if they affect appearance, surgical removal can be considered.

caption_zh: 这是一张头部的照片，可以看到发际线处一个单发的圆形结节，隆起皮肤表面，表面光滑，诊断为表皮囊肿？

Further evaluation, including a skin biopsy, is recommended to confirm the diagnosis.

caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示上肢出现了一个淡红色的扁平损害，表面粗糙，覆盖着薄层的鳞屑，这是原位鳞状细胞癌的典型表现。原位鳞状细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常起源于表皮层，具有良性发展的倾向，但若不及时治疗，有可能发展为侵袭性鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the description provided and the appearance of a pale red flat lesion with rough surface and thin layer of scales on the upper limb, the diagnosis is consistent with in situ squamous cell carcinoma. In situ squamous cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that typically originates in the epidermis layer with a tendency for benign growth, but if left untreated, it may progress to invasive squamous cell carcinoma.

caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a pale red flat lesion on the back of the hand, with a rough surface and a thin layer of scales, consistent with the characteristics of in situ squamous cell carcinoma. In situ squamous cell carcinoma is a precancerous lesion that usually grows slowly, with locally invasive growth and a potential risk of progressing to squamous cell carcinoma. Further histopathological examination is recommended to confirm the diagnosis and to develop an appropriate treatment plan.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个黑褐色的斑片，边缘不清楚，形状不规则，诊断为发育不良痣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个黑褐色的斑块，边缘不清晰，形状不规则，符合发育不良痣的临床特征。发育不良痣是一种在皮肤上出现的色素沉着不均匀、形态不规则的良性皮肤病变，通常是由于色素细胞在胚胎发育过程中的异常分布或增殖引起的。这种痣通常是良性的，但仍需定期随访观察，以排除恶性变化的可能性。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a dark brown patch with unclear borders and irregular shape, consistent with the clinical features of a developmental nevus. A developmental nevus is a benign skin lesion characterized by uneven pigmentation and irregular morphology on the skin, usually caused by abnormal distribution or proliferation of pigment cells during embryonic development. Although these nevi are typically benign, regular follow-up is still necessary to rule out the possibility of malignant transformation.

caption_zh: 这是一张足趾部的照片，可以看到指甲旁一个暗红色的团块状凸起，表面光滑如球样。诊断为化脓性肉芽肿。
caption_zh_polish: 化脓性肉芽肿是一种常见的皮肤感染性疾病，通常由细菌感染引起，局部会出现红肿、疼痛、渗液等症状。治疗通常包括局部抗生素药膏或口服抗生素，必要时可能需要手术引流。患者应保持局部清洁干燥，避免挤压或抓挠，及时就医以防止病情恶化。
caption_zh_polish_en: Pyogenic granuloma is a common skin infection, usually caused by bacterial infection, characterized by local redness, swelling, pain, and discharge. Treatment typically involves topical antibiotic ointments or oral antibiotics, and surgical drainage may be necessary if needed. Patients should keep the affected area clean and dry, avoid squeezing or scratching, and seek medical attention promptly to prevent worsening of the condition.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到孤立存在的紫红色结节，表面光滑，与周边分界清楚。诊断为血管瘤
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个孤立存在的紫红色结节，表面光滑，与周边有清晰的分界线。根据病灶的特征，结合临床表现，可以初步诊断为血管瘤。血管瘤是一种常见的血管发育异常疾病，通常是良性的，但在特定情况下可能需要治疗或随访观察。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows an isolated purplish-red nodule with a smooth surface and clear boundaries with the surrounding area. Based on the characteristics of the lesion and clinical presentation, a preliminary diagnosis of hemangioma can be made. Hemangioma is a common vascular developmental abnormality, usually benign, but may require treatment or follow-up observation in specific cases.

caption_zh: 这是一张鼻部的照片，可以看到一个暗褐色的斑块，略有浸润，部分表面有结痂，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示鼻部出现了一个暗褐色的斑块，呈现出部分浸润的特征，表面部分形成了结痂。根据病灶的特点，初步诊断为基底细胞癌，一种常见的皮肤癌。患者应尽快就医，进行详细的皮肤检查和必要的组织活检以确认诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of the nose showing a dark brown patch with some infiltration and crusting on the surface, suggestive of basal cell carcinoma. The patient should seek medical attention promptly for a thorough skin examination and necessary biopsy to confirm the diagnosis.

caption_zh: 这是一张肩背部的照片，可以看到一个褐色的斑丘疹，略隆起于皮肤表面，形状不规则，表面光滑，边界清楚，诊断为黑素细胞痣。
caption_zh_polish: 这是一张肩背部的照片，显示一个褐色的斑丘疹，略微隆起于皮肤表面，形状不规则，表面光滑，边界清晰，经过检查诊断为黑色素细胞痣。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photograph shows a brown papule on the shoulder and back, slightly raised above the skin surface, with irregular shape, smooth surface, and clear borders, diagnosed as a melanocytic nevus after examination.

caption_zh: 这是一张面部的照片，可以看到下颌角处一个淡红色的结节状损害，表面粗糙，结节中央破溃糜烂。诊断为鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 患者面部下颌角处出现了一个淡红色的结节状损害，表面粗糙，结节中央破溃糜烂，符合鳞状细胞癌的特征。鳞状细胞癌是一种常见的恶性肿瘤，通常起源于表皮组织，具有侵袭性和转移性。治疗方面一般包括手术切除、放疗和化疗等综合治疗方案。
caption_zh_polish_en: Facial photograph showing a pale red nodular lesion with rough surface and central ulceration and necrosis at the angle of the jaw. This is indicative of squamous cell carcinoma. Squamous cell carcinoma is a common malignant tumor that typically originates from the epidermal tissues, exhibiting invasiveness and metastatic potential. Treatment usually involves a combination of surgical resection, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy.

caption_zh: 这是一张耳部的照片，可以看到耳轮处一个鲜红色的斑块，略有浸润，部分表面有结痂，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示耳轮处有一个鲜红色的斑块，呈现出浸润生长的特征，部分表面已经形成结痂，这种病变的临床诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish_en: Basal cell carcinoma is clinically diagnosed based on the presence of a bright red, infiltrative lesion with some areas crusted over, as seen at the helix in this image.

caption_zh: 这是一张耳部的照片，可以看到外耳廓处一个鲜红色的半球形结节，表面光滑，周边可见扩张迂曲血管结构，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示外耳廓处一个鲜红色的半球形结节，表面光滑，周边可见扩张迂曲血管结构，这是基底细胞癌的典型表现。基底细胞癌是一种常见的恶性肿瘤，通常起源于皮肤表层，生长缓慢，但若不及时治疗可侵犯深部组织。
caption_zh_polish_en: Basal cell carcinoma is diagnosed based on the presence of a red, smooth-surfaced, dome-shaped nodule at the external ear. It is characterized by dilated and tortuous blood vessels around the lesion. Basal cell carcinoma is a common malignant tumor that typically originates from the skin's basal layer, grows slowly, but can invade deeper tissues if not treated promptly.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个紫红色的单发结节，与周边分界清楚，表面光滑，诊断为卡波西肉瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个紫红色的单发结节，与周边组织分界清晰，表面光滑，符合卡波西肉瘤的临床表现。卡波西肉瘤是一种恶性软组织肿瘤，通常表现为单个、边界清晰的肿块，常见于四肢等部位。确诊通常需要通过组织活检和免疫组化检查。
caption_zh_polish_en: This photo shows a purplish-red solitary nodule with well-defined borders and smooth surface, consistent with the clinical presentation of Kaposi's sarcoma. Kaposi's sarcoma is a malignant soft tissue tumor that typically presents as a single, well-demarcated mass, commonly found on the limbs. Diagnosis usually requires tissue biopsy and immunohistochemical studies.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个淡红色的结节样损害，表面粗糙，上面有薄层的鳞屑。诊断为鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个淡红色的结节状损害，表面粗糙，覆盖有薄层的鳞状上皮，符合鳞状细胞癌的临床表现。鳞状细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常起源于表皮组织的鳞状上皮细胞，易发生在日光暴露过度的部位，如头部、颈部和手部。治疗方案通常包括手术切除、放射治疗和化疗等。
caption_zh_polish_en: The image shows a pale red nodular lesion with a rough surface and a thin layer of scales, consistent with the clinical presentation of squamous cell carcinoma. Squamous cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that typically originates from the squamous epithelial cells of the epidermis. It often occurs in sun-exposed areas such as the head, neck, and hands. Treatment options usually include surgical excision, radiation therapy, and chemotherapy.

caption_zh: 这是一张下肢的照片，可以看到一个淡褐色的斑片，边缘不清楚，形状尚规则，诊断为发育不良痣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了下肢上的淡褐色斑块，边缘不清晰，形状尚算规则，根据病灶的特征和临床表现，可能是色素痣。建议进一步行皮肤学检查以排除其他潜在的皮肤疾病。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the description and appearance of the light brown patch on the lower limb with unclear borders and relatively regular shape, this may be a pigmented nevus. Further dermatological evaluation is recommended to rule out other potential skin conditions.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个黄褐色的疣状损害，中央糜烂溃疡结痂，诊断为鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示出黄褐色的疣状损害，中央糜烂溃疡结痂，这是鳞状细胞癌的典型表现。鳞状细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常与长期日晒有关。治疗包括手术切除、放疗和化疗等。预后取决于病变的大小、深度和转移情况。
caption_zh_polish_en: The picture shows a yellow-brown verrucous lesion with a central ulcerative scab, which is characteristic of squamous cell carcinoma. Squamous cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer often associated with chronic sun exposure. Treatment options include surgical excision, radiation therapy, and chemotherapy. Prognosis depends on the size, depth, and metastasis of the lesion.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个暗红色的斑块，与周边分界清楚，中央凹陷，边缘略隆起，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个暗红色的斑块，与周围组织分界清楚，中央凹陷，边缘略微隆起，这些特征符合基底细胞癌的表现。基底细胞癌是皮肤最常见的恶性肿瘤之一，通常发生在头部和颈部，其特征包括生长缓慢、边界清晰、中央凹陷、表面溃疡、出血等。确诊通常需要进行组织活检。治疗方式包括手术切除、冷冻疗法、放射治疗等。
caption_zh_polish_en: This photo shows a dark red patch with clear borders from surrounding tissues, central depression, and slightly elevated edges, which are consistent with the presentation of basal cell carcinoma. Basal cell carcinoma is one of the most common malignant tumors of the skin, typically occurring on the head and neck. Its features include slow growth, well-defined borders, central depression, surface ulceration, bleeding, etc. Diagnosis usually requires a tissue biopsy. Treatment options include surgical excision, cryotherapy, radiation therapy, etc.

caption_zh: 这是一张鼻部的照片，可以看到一个褐红色的斑块，略有浸润，部分表面有结痂，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示鼻部出现了一个褐红色的斑块，呈现出部分浸润性生长并有结痂形成，这符合基底细胞癌的表现特征。基底细胞癌是一种最常见的皮肤癌，通常生长缓慢且罕见转移，但若不及时治疗可能会侵犯周围组织。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo showing a brownish-red patch on the nose, with signs of infiltration and crusting, consistent with basal cell carcinoma. Basal cell carcinoma is the most common type of skin cancer, typically growing slowly and rarely metastasizing, but if left untreated, it can invade surrounding tissues.

caption_zh: 这是一张口唇部的照片，可以看到上唇中央一个淡红色的小结节，周边可见少量扩张迂曲的血管，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示口唇上唇中央有一个淡红色的小结节，周围可见少量扩张迂曲的血管，这是基底细胞癌的典型表现，基底细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常生长缓慢，但可以侵犯周围组织。治疗通常包括手术切除、冷冻疗法、放射治疗或局部化疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the photo showing a pale red nodule in the center of the upper lip with a few dilated and twisted blood vessels around it, this is a typical presentation of basal cell carcinoma. Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that usually grows slowly but can invade surrounding tissues. Treatment typically involves surgical removal, cryotherapy, radiation therapy, or topical chemotherapy.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个淡红色的结节，隆起于皮肤表面，上覆少量薄层鳞屑。诊断为角化棘皮瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个淡红色的结节，突起在皮肤表面，表面覆盖有少量薄层鳞屑。角化棘皮瘤是一种常见的良性皮肤病变，通常呈现为表皮增生形成的圆形或椭圆形结节，常见于头部、颈部和躯干等部位。这种病变通常不具有恶性转变的倾向，但定期随访和检查仍然很重要。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a pale red nodule protruding from the skin surface, covered with a small amount of thin scales. Keratoacanthoma is a common benign skin lesion characterized by round or oval nodules formed by epidermal hyperplasia. It is often found on the head, neck, and trunk. This condition usually does not have a tendency for malignant transformation, but regular follow-up and examination are still important.

caption_zh: 这是一张上肢的照片，可以看到一个暗红色的扁平损害，表面粗糙，上面有薄层的鳞屑。诊断为原位鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示上肢出现一个暗红色的扁平损害，表面粗糙，伴有薄层的鳞屑，这些特征符合原位鳞状细胞癌的临床表现。原位鳞状细胞癌是一种非侵袭性的表皮癌症，通常在皮肤暴露部位出现，早期症状常为局部皮肤损害。治疗通常包括手术切除、冷冻疗法或局部放射治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: In this photo of the upper limb, there is a flat lesion with a dark red color, rough surface, and thin layer of scales, which are consistent with the clinical presentation of in situ squamous cell carcinoma. In situ squamous cell carcinoma is a non-invasive epidermal cancer that typically occurs in sun-exposed areas of the skin, presenting early symptoms as localized skin lesions. Treatment usually involves surgical excision, cryotherapy, or local radiation therapy.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一处大片的炎性淡红斑片，稍隆起于皮面，浸润肿胀。诊断为转移性癌
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示皮肤上有一大片炎性淡红色斑块，稍微隆起，并且有浸润性肿胀。根据病灶的特征，可以考虑转移性癌的可能性，但还需要进行进一步的检查以确认诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: This image shows a large area of ​​inflammatory pale red patches on the skin, slightly raised with infiltration and swelling. Based on the characteristics of the lesion, the possibility of metastatic cancer can be considered, but further investigations are needed to confirm the diagnosis.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个黑褐色的斑块，形状对称，边缘尚规则，颜色不均匀，诊断为原位黑素瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个黑褐色的对称斑块，边缘较规则但颜色不均匀，这符合原位黑素瘤的特征。原位黑素瘤是一种恶性肿瘤前体，通常位于皮肤表面，容易被忽视，但仍需要及时治疗以防止恶变和扩散。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a symmetric black-brown patch with relatively regular edges but uneven color, which is consistent with a diagnosis of in situ melanoma. In situ melanoma is a precancerous lesion of malignant melanoma, usually located on the surface of the skin, which can be easily overlooked but still requires prompt treatment to prevent progression and metastasis.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个淡褐色的扁平大斑片，边界清楚，形状不规则，表面略粗糙，部分有油腻的痂皮，诊断为脂溢性角化病。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个淡褐色的扁平大斑片，边界清晰，形状不规则，表面略显粗糙，部分有油腻的痂皮，这是典型的脂溢性角化病的表现。脂溢性角化病是一种常见的慢性皮肤病，通常在面部、头皮、胸部和背部出现，表现为油脂分泌过多，角质增厚形成鳞屑和痂皮。治疗通常包括局部药物治疗和皮肤护理。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a light brown flat patch with clear borders, irregular shape, slightly rough surface, and greasy scales in some areas, typical of seborrheic keratosis. Seborrheic keratosis is a common chronic skin condition that typically appears on the face, scalp, chest, and back, characterized by excessive sebum production, thickening of the skin leading to scales and crusts. Treatment usually involves topical medications and skincare.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个鲜红色的斑块，中央破溃，糜烂和溃疡，诊断为鳞状细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个鲜红色的斑块，中央出现了破溃、糜烂和溃疡的情况，这些表现符合鳞状细胞癌的特征。鳞状细胞癌是一种常见的皮肤癌，通常起源于表皮层的鳞状细胞，其特征性病理变化包括角化、糜烂和溃疡形成。
caption_zh_polish_en: This image shows a bright red patch with central ulceration, erosion, and ulceration, which are consistent with the features of squamous cell carcinoma. Squamous cell carcinoma is a common type of skin cancer that usually originates from the squamous cells in the epidermis, characterized by pathologic changes such as keratinization, erosion, and ulceration.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个淡褐色至黑褐色的斑块，表面粗糙呈疣状，突起于皮面，与周边分界清楚，诊断为寻常疣。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示皮肤上有一个淡褐色至黑褐色的斑块，表面粗糙呈疣状，突起于皮肤表面，与周围皮肤有明显的分界线，根据病灶的特点和临床表现，可以确诊为寻常疣，是一种常见的皮肤疾病，通常由人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）感染引起。寻常疣通常是良性的，但在部分情况下也可能需要治疗以减轻症状或防止传染给他人。建议就诊皮肤科医生进行进一步的评估和治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: In this photograph, a light brown to dark brown patch with a rough, wart-like surface that protrudes from the skin can be seen, clearly demarcated from the surrounding skin. Based on the characteristics of the lesion and clinical presentation, the diagnosis is common warts. Common warts are a common skin condition usually caused by infection with the human papillomavirus (HPV). While common warts are typically benign, in some cases, treatment may be necessary to alleviate symptoms or prevent transmission to others. It is recommended to consult a dermatologist for further evaluation and treatment.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个暗红色的斑块，与周边分界清楚，中央凹陷，边缘略隆起，诊断为基底细胞癌。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个暗红色的斑块，与周围组织有清晰的分界，中央呈现凹陷，边缘略微隆起，这些特征符合基底细胞癌的临床表现。基底细胞癌是皮肤最常见的恶性肿瘤类型之一，通常生长缓慢，但若不及时治疗，有可能侵犯周围组织和器官。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photo shows a dark red patch with clear boundaries with the surrounding tissues, central depression, and slightly raised edges, which are typical features of basal cell carcinoma. Basal cell carcinoma is one of the most common types of skin cancer, typically growing slowly, but if not treated promptly, it can invade surrounding tissues and organs.

caption_zh_polish: 这张图片无法提供足够的信息来做出准确的诊断。可能需要进一步的临床检查和评估才能确定疾病的类型和严重程度。
caption_zh_polish_en: This image does not provide enough information for an accurate diagnosis. Further clinical examinations and evaluations may be needed to determine the type and severity of the disease.

caption_zh: 这是一张手部的照片，可以看到手背处一个淡红色的结节，隆起于皮肤表面，上覆少量薄层鳞屑。诊断为角化棘皮瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 角化棘皮瘤是一种常见的皮肤病，通常表现为皮肤表面的小而坚硬的突起，常见于手部、足部以及头部。这种病变是由于皮肤过度增生形成，通常是良性的，不会转变为恶性肿瘤。治疗方面，可以选择手术切除、冷冻疗法或激光疗法等方法。定期随访是非常重要的，以便观察病变有无恶变的迹象。
caption_zh_polish_en: Keratoacanthoma is a common skin condition characterized by small, hard growths on the skin surface, often found on the hands, feet, and head. This condition is caused by excessive skin growth and is usually benign, not tending to become malignant tumors. Treatment options may include surgical removal, cryotherapy, or laser therapy. Regular follow-up is crucial for monitoring any signs of malignant transformation.

caption_zh: 这是一张头部的照片，可以看到头皮处一个淡褐色的扁平大斑片，边界清楚，形状不规则，表面略粗糙，部分有油腻的痂皮，诊断为脂溢性角化。
caption_zh_polish: 这张头部照片显示头皮上有一个淡褐色的扁平大斑片，边界清晰，形状不规则，表面略显粗糙，部分区域有油腻的痂皮，这是脂溢性角化的特征表现。脂溢性角化是一种常见的慢性皮肤病，通常是由于皮脂腺分泌过多引起的，常见于头皮、面部等部位。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of the head showing a light brown, flat, irregularly shaped patch on the scalp with clear borders and a slightly rough surface, accompanied by greasy scales in some areas, indicative of seborrheic keratosis. Seborrheic keratosis is a common chronic skin condition, often caused by overactive sebaceous glands, commonly found on the scalp, face, and other areas.

caption_zh: 这是一张颈部的照片，可以看到颈侧一个黑褐色的半球形隆起，高于皮肤表面，表面粗糙，诊断为脂溢性角化。
caption_zh_polish: 脂溢性角化是一种常见的皮肤病，通常表现为皮肤表面出现黑褐色或黄色的凸起，常见于面部、头皮和颈部等部位。这种病变是由于皮脂腺分泌过多，导致皮肤角质层增厚并角化不良所致。脂溢性角化通常是良性的，除非出现感染或炎症等并发症，一般不需要特殊治疗，定期保持局部清洁即可。
caption_zh_polish_en: Seborrheic keratosis is a common skin condition characterized by brownish or yellowish raised spots on the skin surface, commonly found on the face, scalp, and neck. This condition is caused by overactive sebaceous glands, leading to thickening of the skin's outer layer and abnormal keratinization. Seborrheic keratosis is usually benign and does not require specific treatment unless complications such as infection or inflammation occur. Regularly keeping the affected area clean is usually sufficient.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到群集的褐色的斑疹，与周边分界清楚，表面光滑，诊断为雀斑样痣
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示有群集的褐色斑点，与周围皮肤有明显的分界，表面光滑，符合雀斑样痣的特征。雀斑样痣是一种常见的良性皮肤病变，通常是在皮肤暴露部位出现，多见于面部、颈部和手臂等部位。这种痣一般不需要治疗，但需要定期观察变化，以排除恶性变化的可能性。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the description of the photo, the presence of clustered brown spots with clear borders and smooth surface suggests a diagnosis of freckle-like nevus. Freckle-like nevus is a common benign skin lesion that typically appears on sun-exposed areas of the skin, such as the face, neck, and arms. This type of nevus usually does not require treatment but should be regularly monitored for any signs of malignant transformation.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个鲜红色的半球形肿块，高于皮肤表面，没有破溃，诊断为脓肿。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片展示了一个高于皮肤表面的鲜红色半球形肿块，没有破溃，根据症状和表现，初步诊断为皮肤脓肿。脓肿是由于细菌感染引起的皮下脓液积聚所致，常见于皮肤的感染性疾病，通常需要通过手术引流或抗生素治疗。
caption_zh_polish_en: The photograph shows a raised, red, dome-shaped lump above the skin surface without any signs of rupture, indicating a preliminary diagnosis of a skin abscess. An abscess is a collection of pus underneath the skin caused by a bacterial infection, commonly seen in infectious skin conditions, often requiring drainage through surgery or treatment with antibiotics.

caption_zh: 这是一张颈部的照片，可以看到颈侧一个黑褐色的半球形隆起，高于皮肤表面，局部呈分叶状，表面粗糙，诊断为脂溢性角化。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示颈部出现一个黑褐色的半球形隆起，高于皮肤表面，局部呈分叶状，表面粗糙，这符合脂溢性角化的临床表现。脂溢性角化是一种常见的皮肤疾病，通常表现为角质过度增生和脂肪排泄不畅，导致皮肤局部出现颗粒状或鳞屑状的皮损。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of the neck showing a dark brownish raised lesion, higher than the skin surface, with a rough surface and lobulated appearance, consistent with seborrheic keratosis. Seborrheic keratosis is a common skin condition characterized by overgrowth of keratin and impaired sebum secretion, leading to localized grainy or scaly skin lesions.

caption_zh: 这张照片可以看到一个正常肤色的扁平斑块，表面粗糙呈疣状，略突起于皮面，与周边分界清楚，诊断为扁平疣？
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示一个表面粗糙呈疣状、略微突起且与周围皮肤清晰分界的正常肤色扁平斑块，根据病灶的特点和表现，确诊为扁平疣。扁平疣是由人乳头瘤病毒感染引起的常见皮肤病变，通常无痛，多发生于手部和足部的皮肤上。治疗可选择冷冻疗法、药物局部涂抹或外科手术切除等方法。
caption_zh_polish_en: Based on the characteristics and appearance of the lesion in the photo, the diagnosis of flat warts is confirmed. Flat warts are common skin lesions caused by human papillomavirus infection, typically painless and often seen on the skin of the hands and feet. Treatment options include cryotherapy, topical medications, or surgical excision.

caption_zh: 这是一张颈部的照片，可以看到多个正常肤色的息肉样凸起，表面光滑，与基底间有细蒂相连，诊断为软纤维瘤
caption_zh_polish: 软纤维瘤是一种常见的良性肿瘤，通常发生在皮肤或皮下组织中。它通常是由于软组织细胞增生引起的，常见于头颈部和身体的其他部位。软纤维瘤通常是无痛的，表面光滑，与周围组织有明显的分界。治疗通常是手术切除，预后良好。
caption_zh_polish_en: Fibroma is a common benign tumor that typically occurs in the skin or subcutaneous tissue. It is usually caused by the proliferation of soft tissue cells and can be found in various parts of the body, including the head, neck, and other areas. Fibromas are typically painless, have a smooth surface, and are well-demarcated from surrounding tissues. Treatment usually involves surgical removal, and the prognosis is generally good.

caption_zh: 这是一张上肢的照片，可以看到一个淡褐色的扁平大斑片，边界清楚，形状不规则，表面略粗糙，部分有油腻的痂皮，诊断为脂溢性角化。
caption_zh_polish: 这张照片显示了一个上肢区域的淡褐色扁平大斑片，边界清晰，形状不规则，表面略显粗糙，部分有油腻的痂皮，这些表现符合脂溢性角化的特征。脂溢性角化是一种常见的皮肤病，通常表现为皮肤局部角质过度增生和脂腺分泌异常，可出现在面部、颈部、胸部和背部等部位。治疗可以选择局部角质软化剂和角质溶解剂，帮助减轻症状。
caption_zh_polish_en: This is a photo of the upper limb showing a pale brown flat patch with clear borders, irregular shape, slightly rough surface, and some greasy crusts, which are consistent with features of seborrheic keratosis. Seborrheic keratosis is a common skin condition characterized by localized overgrowth of keratin and abnormal sebaceous gland secretion, which can occur on the face, neck, chest, back, and other areas. Treatment may involve the use of topical keratolytics and keratolytic agents to help alleviate symptoms.
